analysis: The PR is a benchmark-tooling change only. scripts/gptoss_profile/summary.py:68-70 now copies two numeric report fields, prefillChunkTokens and maxBatchedTokensPerStep, into the prefill summary row via report.get(), alongside the existing soloPrefillStripeTokens. The new test at scripts/gptoss_profile/tests/test_integrity.py:101-115 checks that both the new and legacy schemas keep the engine geometry. I found no changes to the coordinator WebSocket contract, attestation, App Attest authorization, key handling, encryption, or the prefix-cache SSD tier (T-041). The new fields are not written to the CSV, because the columns list at summary.py:129-131 is unchanged. They appear only in summary.json, which is produced by the local profiling script. The values come from the local engine's own raw output, which summarize() already revalidates (summary.py:107) before summarizing. The validate() function is not in this diff, so I did not check whether it constrains the new fields. The fields are plain numbers or None, are not rendered in the markdown table, and carry no prompt content or secrets. No new attack surface, trust-boundary change or invalidated threat assumption is visible. One residual point is that report.get() returns unvalidated values, which matters only for benchmark integrity, not for security. The T-041 context is relevant only to the extent that the profiler pins the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch (tested at lines 126-132). That behaviour is unchanged by this PR.
